Fine lunch with extraordinary view & space
May 2023 • Family
Came here with my mom for a fine lunch.

1. Location: in the middle of Hanoi, luxury area but not too vibrant. Should come here on a sunny day to take marvellous photos on the street

2. Space: The restaurant has different areas to choose based on your interest, I chose a perfect table next to the window with an outstanding view to Sofitel Metropole Hotel across the road. Design is high-end but not overwhelmed, not too crowded. Such a perfect place for lowkey people like me.

3. Food: We got Temptation Set Menu with 3 courses, freshly start with smoked salmon salad & creamy cauliflower soup. Beef filet with red wine sauce was too good to be true. The most impressive thing was strawberry sorbet, fantastic ending.
It’s was a pity that seafood quenelle failed though…the French oyster’s smell wasn’t processed well.

4. Suitable for: family, couples

5. Price: 690,000++vnd/ 3 courses (drinks excluded)

Overall: definitely gonna come back to discover more
